flags: Our page contradicts the sources: it says 'כ-800 דירות בארבעה מגדלי מגורים בני 46 קומות ... על פני מעל 100 דונם'; nadlancenter 12.3.2025 says Tshuva's Park Bavli 'כולל, שני מגדלים בני 44 קומות'. Walla 3.6.2009 gives the wider Bavli-Dekel plan as 7 towers up to 44 floors, 988 apartments, 108 dunam. The 46/48-floor figures that surface in searches belong to Hagag's separate H Masterpiece tower (Bavli 3; ice: 48 floors, 247 units), on land Hagag bought from Tshuva.
The unit count of Elad's two towers was not found in any source read, so there is no 'דירות' row.
